description: Logical audit rows an independent DB observer returns under /data/rawRows/<source>. Field names come from the backend audit columns (backend/db/commands.cds CommandAudits joined to CommandRecords by commandId, plus CommandAudits.auditFactsJson keys written by ApplicationCommands/PolicyCommandGuard/CommandRepository). Plan §7.4 audit content the backend does not record yet is listed under pendingFields with the plan reference; cases may read those names, and the names are a Step 3 addition request, not a backend fact. Case assertions on the audit sources use only these names; verification/cases/check_vocabulary.py rejects any other name.
whereRule: AssertionEngine requires every where key to be non-null on every row of the source. A where filter on an audit source may therefore use only fields with presence=ALWAYS. CONDITIONAL and PENDING fields may be projected (field) only on rows already selected by ALWAYS fields, so that every selected row carries them.
outcomeRule: outcome is the command-response outcome of contracts/domain-vocabulary.json (APPLIED, ACCEPTED_PENDING_EXTERNAL, WAITING_APPROVAL, NEEDS_INPUT, REJECTED, CONFLICT, HELD). A structured error code is never written into outcome; it is errorCode. A denial with code FORBIDDEN is outcome=REJECTED, errorCode=FORBIDDEN.

sources.meaning: Command audit. One row per CommandAudits row, including the expected-denial audit written after rollback and the replay audit of an existing command record. Queries are not in this source (plan §7.4: query audit is distinguished from business state changes).
Query audit. One row per audited read (getObject, searchObjects, getInventory, getEvidence, ...), including a denied read. Separate from command audit so a read never counts as a business change.
sources.pendingReason: Plan §7.4 requires a query audit distinguished from state changes. The backend writes no query audit row yet; Step 3 must add a table or log with these fields.

fields.name: auditId
fields.meaning: audit row identity

fields.name: organizationId
fields.meaning: server-resolved organization of the authenticated request

fields.name: actorId
fields.meaning: server-authenticated actor (never a payload actor)

fields.name: commandId
fields.meaning: CommandRecords row the audit belongs to; a replay audit points at the original record

fields.name: commandIdempotencyKey
fields.meaning: the effect key of the audited command; every executed command carries one (CommandRequests.parse)

fields.name: capabilityId
fields.meaning: audited action; system sweeps use their own capability id (for example inventoryValidityBoundary)

fields.name: canonicalHash
fields.meaning: canonical intent hash of the audited request

fields.name: outcome
fields.meaning: command-response outcome (outcomeRule)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.meaning: audit write instant

fields.name: transactionId
fields.product: observer derivation: text of the 64-bit PostgreSQL transaction id (xid8) of the transaction that inserted the CommandAudits row, derived from its xmin system column
fields.meaning: lets a case prove the audit and the business effects committed in one transaction; the same derivation applies to every raw row that exposes transactionId

fields.name: replayAttempt
fields.meaning: true when the row audits a replayed request of an existing command record

fields.name: expectedDenial
fields.meaning: true when the row is the denial audit committed after the effect transaction rolled back

fields.name: errorCode
fields.presentWhen: outcome is not APPLIED or ACCEPTED_PENDING_EXTERNAL
fields.meaning: structured error code of the audited result

fields.name: targetId
fields.meaning: server-resolved target of the command

fields.name: beforeRevision
fields.meaning: target revision checked at the commit boundary

fields.name: afterRevision
fields.presentWhen: the applied result returned a revision
fields.meaning: target revision after the effect

fields.name: definitionVersion
fields.presentWhen: the request carried a definition version
fields.meaning: definition version of the audited request

fields.name: capabilityVersion
fields.meaning: capability semantic version

fields.name: effectClass
fields.meaning: effect class used for policy selection

fields.name: policyVersion
fields.presentWhen: the command reached policy selection and applied; plan §7.4 also needs it on denials after policy selection (pending)
fields.meaning: version of the current command policy used

fields.name: policyHash
fields.meaning: content hash of that policy

fields.name: approvalId
fields.presentWhen: an approval was bound to the command
fields.meaning: the approval consumed or checked

fields.name: effectRefs
fields.product: CommandAudits.effectRefs (object of workId, activityId, obligationId, revision, commandId when present)
fields.meaning: safe result references

fields.name: workId
fields.meaning: work of the audited effect

fields.name: delegatorId
fields.meaning: server-resolved delegator of an agent or worker request

fields.name: reason
fields.meaning: reason recorded by the server from the management request

fields.name: before
fields.meaning: business state of the target before the effect

fields.name: after
fields.meaning: business state of the target after the effect

fields.name: requestId
fields.meaning: reference to the original request the audit covers

fields.name: approvalRefs
fields.meaning: list of approvals used; [] when none (approvalId covers only one bound approval)

fields.name: evidenceIds
fields.meaning: list of evidence/basis ids the command relied on

fields.name: movementId
fields.meaning: movement created by the audited effect (effectRefs has no movement yet)

fields.name: grantRevision
fields.meaning: grant revision checked at the commit boundary

fields.name: proposalHash
fields.meaning: dry-run diff hash an emergency repair applied

fields.name: sweepId
fields.meaning: retention sweep run identity

fields.name: queryAuditId
fields.meaning: query audit row identity

fields.name: organizationId
fields.meaning: server-resolved organization

fields.name: actorId
fields.meaning: server-authenticated reader

fields.name: capabilityId
fields.meaning: query capability

fields.name: outcome
fields.meaning: READ when data was returned, REJECTED when the read was denied

fields.name: createdAt
fields.meaning: audit write instant

fields.name: errorCode
fields.meaning: structured error code of the denied read

fields.name: targetId
fields.meaning: object read; never a different organization's identity on denial

retiredNames.name: result
retiredNames.replacement: outcome (APPLIED/REJECTED...) plus errorCode for a code such as FORBIDDEN

retiredNames.name: kind
retiredNames.replacement: DENIAL: outcome not APPLIED; MUTATION: outcome=APPLIED; QUERY: source queryAudit

retiredNames.name: authorizationResult
retiredNames.replacement: outcome/errorCode (one row cannot be both denied and applied); use expectedDenial
audit rows selected by commandIdempotencyKey with outcome/errorCode
